sources.title: Sierra Leone travel warning and consular information
sources.publisher: Ministry of Foreign and European Affairs of the Republic of Croatia
sources.officialityEvidence: Croatia's live Foreign Ministry country notice, dated 6 May 2026, specifically addresses Croatian travellers and says a visa is required while deferring entry conditions to Sierra Leone authorities.
sources.supportingExcerpt: Za putovanje u Sijera Leone hrvatskim državljanima je potrebna viza.

sources.title: Liberia travel warning and consular information
sources.publisher: Ministry of Foreign and European Affairs of the Republic of Croatia
sources.officialityEvidence: Croatia's live Foreign Ministry country notice, dated 6 May 2026, specifically states that Croatian travellers need a Liberian visa but provides no issuance timing.
sources.supportingExcerpt: Za putovanje u Liberiju hrvatskim državljanima je potrebna viza.

sources.title: Palestine travel warning
sources.publisher: Ministry of Foreign and European Affairs of the Republic of Croatia
sources.officialityEvidence: Croatia's live Foreign Ministry Palestine notice, dated 28 February 2026, treats the West Bank and Gaza operational situation separately and does not give a territory-wide Croatian visitor status.
sources.supportingExcerpt: Sigurnost na Zapadnoj obali i u Gazi je bitno narušena.

sources.title: Syria travel warning
sources.publisher: Ministry of Foreign and European Affairs of the Republic of Croatia
sources.officialityEvidence: Croatia's live Foreign Ministry Syria notice gives current operational advice to Croatian nationals but does not establish an ordinary visitor visa issuance route.
sources.supportingExcerpt: Hrvatskim državljanima koji se nalaze u Siriji preporučuje se da razmotre napuštanje zemlje.

sources.title: eVisa South Sudan
sources.publisher: Ministry of Interior, Department of E-Visa and Immigration Service, South Sudan
sources.officialityEvidence: The live .gov.ss portal identifies the Ministry of Interior immigration e-visa department and documents pre-travel PDF delivery, but does not publish a Croatian nationality eligibility rule.
sources.supportingExcerpt: Download your e-visa PDF from anywhere within 72 hours.

sources.title: Djibouti eVisa replaces point-of-entry visa
sources.publisher: National Agency for State Information Systems, Republic of Djibouti
sources.officialityEvidence: Djibouti's live e-government guidance establishes electronic pre-travel issuance and replacement of point-of-entry visas, but provides no Croatian ordinary-passport eligibility schedule.
sources.supportingExcerpt: L'eVisa remplace le visa délivré au point d'entrée dans le pays.

sources.title: Sierra Leone Immigration eVisa application translation
sources.publisher: Ministry of Internal Affairs, Republic of Sierra Leone
sources.officialityEvidence: The live government eVisa service identifies the Ministry of Internal Affairs as operator; its current translation asset says that an approved online application results in border issuance.
sources.supportingExcerpt: Once your visa application has been approved, you'll be issued your Visa upon arrival at the airport or border.
